create_GoInputOutputEvaluator: create a GoInputOutputEvaluator instance to compile and evaluate Go programs against expected input/output pairs
compile_Go_program: compile a Go source file into an executable binary using the compile_go utility function
process_Go_code: process and detokenize Go source code using the GoProcessor static method
check_Go_outputs: check Go program outputs by running compiled binaries against a list of expected inputs and outputs
run_Go_imports: run Go program compilation with or without go imports enabled via the run_go_imports flag
